meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 它会把你的任务拆成一条条极细的步骤,先登记目标再动手,每完成一步就更新实时清单,并为每条成功标准采集可观测证据,断档后从记录处接着跑。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop、持久化的目标执行,或提到 ulw 等关键词,或需要带检查点的长时间执行时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 跑这个任务,先登记目标再逐步执行。
say.note: 会先建目标和清单,再开始动作。

say.text: 把这几步镜像进 update_plan,标出当前进行中的那一步。
say.note: 一步一条,同时只有一条在进行中。

say.text: 看下 ulw-loop 的当前状态,断档就从记录处接着跑。
say.note: 读取会话状态并续跑,不重新规划。

howto.what_en: It splits your task into ultra-granular steps, registers the goal first, mirrors each step into a live checklist, and collects observable evidence for every success criterion, resuming from records after context loss.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop, durable goal execution, or checkouted long-running delivery, or mention ulw.

say_en.text: Run this with ulw-loop: register the goal first, then execute step by step.
say_en.note: Creates goals and a plan before acting.

say_en.text: Mirror those steps into update_plan and mark the one in progress.
say_en.note: One step per action, one in progress.

say_en.text: Check ulw-loop status and resume from the recorded point.
